aliases: 顾拜旦男爵皮埃尔·德·弗雷迪（法语：Pierre de Frédy, Baron de Coubertin，1863年1月1日—1937年9月2日），现代奥林匹克运动会的发起人，国际奥林匹克委员会（IOC）创始人和第二任主席（1896-1925），奥林匹克五环和奥林匹克会旗设计者。被誉为'现代奥林匹克之父'。
Pierre de Coubertin（法文原名；拉丁化 Pierre de Coubertin；后世常以'现代奥林匹克之父'形容其历史地位）
《英国教育》（L'Éducation en Angleterre，1888）、《公共教育笔记》（Notes sur l'éducation publique，1901）、《体育教育学》（Pédagogie sportive，1922）、《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）等著作的作者
legacy 提示：本档案为净新增，库内与 data/figures 均无 H-COU-* / M-COU-*；前缀 M-COU 在此之前零占用，严禁与其他人物前缀混用
era: 近代（1863年1月1日生于法国巴黎；1883年赴英国考察教育制度；1892年首次提出复兴奥运倡议；1894年索邦大学国际会议创立IOC；1896年雅典首届现代奥运会举行；1925年卸任IOC主席；1937年9月2日卒于日内瓦。生卒年与生平细节主要来自奥林匹克官方档案及顾拜旦本人著述。）
era_en: Modern era (born January 1, 1863 in Paris, France; visited England in 1883 to study educational systems; first proposed Olympic revival in 1892; established IOC at 1894 Sorbonne Congress; first modern Olympics held in Athens in 1896; stepped down as IOC president in 1925; died September 2, 1937 in Geneva. Birth and death dates and biographical details come mainly from official Olympic archives and Coubertin's own writings.)
school: 法国精英教育传统（巴黎政治学院背景）+ 英国公学体育教育理念（托马斯·阿诺德影响）+ 古希腊体育文化复兴运动 + 19世纪末欧洲教育改革思潮 + 国际主义与和平主义思想
style_name: 顾拜旦风格（Coubertinian style）：身心合一的完整人格理想；仪式象征的系统建构；古代资源的创造性转化；制度保障的长期规划思维
courtesy_name: 顾拜旦男爵（Baron de Coubertin，贵族爵位）
pseudonym: 乔治·霍尔（George Hohrod，1912年斯德哥尔摩奥运会文学比赛金奖笔名）——此笔名系顾拜旦本人使用，非后世追认。
historical_significance: 顾拜旦是现代奥林匹克运动的创始人，其历史贡献主要体现在五个方面。其一，理念复兴：将古代奥运会精神创造性转化为现代国际体育盛事，提出'重要并非取胜，而是参与'的奥林匹克信条。其二，制度建设：创建国际奥委会（IOC）这一持久性国际组织，设计其治理结构与决策程序。其三，符号建构：设计奥林匹克五环标志（1913年）、奥林匹克旗帜（1914年）、确立圣火传递仪式（1928年提议），构建完整的仪式象征体系。其四，教育创新：倡导'肌肉与智识的永久统一'，推动体育纳入正规教育体系。其五，全球影响：奥林匹克运动已发展为他国参与的全球性盛事，28届夏季奥运会和24届冬季奥运会，成为促进国际理解与和平的重要平台。
unique_thinking: 顾拜旦的独特之处在于：他将古代奥林匹克传统与现代教育理想相结合，创造了一套完整的体育哲学与制度体系。他的独门路径是：其一，身心合一法——批判现代教育的分裂，主张恢复古希腊kalokagathia（美善合一）理想（M-COU-001）；其二，参与至上法——重新定义成功标准，强调过程价值高于结果（M-COU-002）；其三，古代复兴法——创造性转化古代资源应对现代危机（M-COU-003）；其四，国际理解法——以体育为媒介促进跨国界友谊（M-COU-004）；其五，业余主义法——维护体育精神的纯洁性（M-COU-005）；其六，品格锻造法——将体育视为道德教育工具（M-COU-006）；其七，仪式象征法——通过符号仪式建构集体认同（M-COU-007）；其八，机构奠基法——以制度化保障理想实现（M-COU-008）；其九，文化融合法——体育与艺术并重培养完整人格（M-COU-009）；其十，和平竞争法——将暴力冲突转化为文明竞技（M-COU-010）。与古代奥运创始人相比，他更注重制度设计；与单纯体育家相比，他更具教育家视野。
mode_ids_note: M-COU-001~010 为本档案深度挖掘的 10 个 v6 思维模式。卡面 literal 写定 'M-COU-001~010'，与 code 规范（figure_code 去空格、大写、至多 8 字符）一致：'Coubertin' 取前三字母 COU，与库内同期落地惯例同构。实测 data/modes_data.json 与 data/figures：'M-COU' 前缀零占用，figure_code 'Coubertin' 不在库亦不在 figures 目录，故无需改写前缀。

cross_references.relation_note_zh: 顾拜旦复兴古代奥运会的理念直接源于荷马史诗中对奥林匹克竞技的描绘
cross_references.description_zh: 顾拜旦与荷马的关系体现了现代对古代文化资源的创造性转化：荷马史诗中描绘的奥林匹克竞技是顾拜旦复兴古代奥运会的核心灵感来源。荷马呈现了古代体育的精神内核——追求卓越、尊重规则、荣耀与友谊并存——顾拜旦则将这些古代理想转化为现代制度与实践。两人跨越两千余年，共同塑造了奥林匹克运动的文化基因。
cross_references.description_en: The relationship between Coubertin and Homer embodies the creative transformation of ancient cultural resources in modernity: Homeric epics' depictions of Olympic competition were Coubertin's core inspiration for reviving the ancient Games. Homer presented the spiritual essence of ancient sport—pursuit of excellence, respect for rules, coexistence of honor and friendship—while Coubertin transformed these ancient ideals into modern institutions and practices. Spanning over two millennia, both shaped the cultural DNA of the Olympic Movement together.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 荷马档案（H-HOM-001）未来修订时，可在 M-HOM-005 处补一条指向 Coubertin/M-COU-003 的对照：荷马史诗中的竞技描写是顾拜旦古代复兴法的核心文本依据。

cross_references.relation_note_zh: 同为19世纪末20世纪初的思想家，修昔底德追求历史真相，顾拜旦追求体育精神，二者都以制度性思维应对时代危机
cross_references.description_zh: 顾拜旦与修昔底德虽然领域不同，但都面对'危机—重建'的时代命题。修昔底德在伯罗奔尼撒战争后记录人性不变的结构，顾拜旦在普法战争失败后重建法国青年体魄与意志。两人都强调证据与理性：修昔底德要求历史叙述忠实于事实，顾拜旦强调体育竞赛应基于公平规则与真实能力。差异在于：修昔底德关注政治权力的运作逻辑，顾拜旦关注人类精神的升华路径。
cross_references.description_en: Coubertin and Thucydides, though working in different fields, both faced the era's crisis-reconstruction question. Thucydides recorded invariant human structures after the Peloponnesian War; Coubertin rebuilt French youth's physique and will after France's defeat in the Franco-Prussian War. Both emphasized evidence and reason: Thucydides demanded historical narrative fidelity to facts, Coubertin insisted sport competition be based on fair rules and genuine ability. The difference: Thucydides examined political power dynamics, Coubertin explored paths to spiritual elevation.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 修昔底德档案（H-THU-001）未来修订时，可在 M-THU-001 处补一条指向 Coubertin/M-COU-008 的对照：两人都通过制度设计回应时代危机，修昔底德用史书，顾拜旦用国际组织。

caveats: 生平材料的性质：顾拜旦的生平有详尽记录，主要来自其本人著述和IOC官方档案。但部分细节（如早年游历的具体时间、与英国教育家的具体交往）存在不同说法，引用时应标注不确定性。
文本传承：顾拜旦的著作经过多次修订，不同版本可能存在差异。《奥林匹克回忆录》成书于1931年，部分回忆带有事后建构色彩，应与其他史料交叉验证。
时代局限：顾拜旦的业余主义原则带有明显的阶级偏见，限制了下层阶级参与；他对女性参与的抵制反映了当时的性别观念。现代奥林匹克运动已在这些方面做出修正，引用时应区分历史语境与当代价值。
理想与现实的张力：顾拜旦的奥林匹克理想常被政治力量利用或扭曲（如1936年柏林奥运会、1980年和1984年奥运会抵制事件）。档案提炼的思维模式是其理念的系统化重构，不等于历史实践的完整呈现。
跨文化解读：顾拜旦的思想深受英国公学教育影响，但其理念在全球传播中被不同文化语境重新诠释。引用时应区分顾拜旦原意与后世诠释。
key_works: 《英国教育》（L'Éducation en Angleterre，1888）——系统介绍英国体育教育理念，奠定顾拜旦体育思想的基础
《公共教育笔记》（Notes sur l'éducation publique，1901）——阐述体育在教育体系中的核心地位
《体育教育学》（Pédagogie sportive，1922）——系统论述体育教育的理论与实践方法
《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）——回顾奥林匹克运动创建历程，包含大量一手史料
《体育颂》（Ode to Sport，1912）——以笔名'乔治·霍尔'发表，获斯德哥尔摩奥运会文学比赛金奖

modes.definition_zh: 人的发展必须是肌肉与智识的永久统一。顾拜旦批判现代教育将身体训练与智力发展割裂，导致'行走的词典'式的畸形培养。他复兴古希腊的kalokagathia（美善合一）理想，主张体育教育应同时培养身体的力量与精神的卓越。身心合一不是简单的并列，而是有机的统一：身体是精神的载体，精神是身体的升华，二者相互促进、不可分割。
modes.definition_en: Human development must be the permanent union of muscles and intellect. Coubertin criticized modern education for splitting physical training from intellectual development, producing 'walking dictionaries.' He revived the ancient Greek ideal of kalokagathia (beauty and goodness in unity), arguing that physical education must cultivate both bodily strength and spiritual excellence. Mind-body unity is not mere parallelism but organic integration: the body is the vessel of spirit, spirit is the elevation of the body — they mutually enhance and cannot be separated.
modes.source_chapter: 《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）；《体育教育学》（Pédagogie sportive，1922）
modes.key_quote_zh: 问题的关键在于恢复肌肉与智识的永久统一，而这种统一在当今已被割裂。我相信这种统一曾经行之有效，但在不利的影响下二者逐渐分离，最终走向完全冷漠——分离变成了相互遗忘。奥林匹亚曾是它们的主要居所，现在已被重建、再生和翻新。
modes.key_quote_en: The pith of the matter is to reestablish the permanent union of muscles and intellect, which we now find dissolved. I am sure that the union was once productive, but as soon as they grew apart under the influence of adverse conditions, they gradually came to a total mutual indifference. Olympia, which was their main residence in the past, is now reconstructed, regenerated and renovated.
process_zh: 识别身心分裂的教育现状与危害
追溯古希腊kalokagathia的完整人格理想
确立体育与智育的并重地位与互促关系
在实践中实现身心有机统一的培养
process_en: Identify the split between physical and intellectual education and its harms
Trace the ancient Greek ideal of kalokagathia — the complete human personality
Establish equal status and mutual reinforcement of physical and intellectual training
Achieve organic mind-body unity through practice
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦批判法国教育培养'行走的词典'，主张恢复体育在教育体系中的核心地位，使身体训练与智力发展并重
他将古代奥运会本身就包含的艺术竞赛（诗歌、雕塑、建筑）纳入现代奥运，体现身心合一的完整教育观
反例警示：若只重视智力而忽视体育，会产生身体孱弱、意志薄弱的畸形人格；反之，只重体育而忽视智力，则会培养出四肢发达、头脑简单的武夫
representative_cases_en: Coubertin criticized French education for producing 'walking dictionaries,' advocating the restoration of physical education as a core subject alongside intellectual development
He incorporated ancient Olympic art competitions (poetry, sculpture, architecture) into the modern Games, reflecting a complete educational vision of mind-body unity

Counterexample: valuing only intellect while neglecting sport produces physically weak and willfully fragile personalities; conversely, valuing only sport while neglecting intellect produces the brute — strong in body but empty in mind

modes.definition_zh: 参与本身比胜利更重要。顾拜旦借美国主教之口提出奥林匹克信条：'奥林匹克比赛中最重要的不是取胜，而是参与；正如生活中最重要的不是征服，而是奋力拼搏。'这一方法将竞赛的价值从结果导向转向过程导向，强调奋斗过程的人格塑造意义，而非最终的胜负结果。
modes.definition_en: Participation itself is more important than victory. Coubertin, borrowing from an American bishop, formulated the Olympic Creed: 'The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not winning but taking part; the most important thing in life is not triumph but the struggle.' This method shifts the value of competition from outcome-oriented to process-oriented, emphasizing the character-building significance of the struggle rather than the final result.
modes.source_chapter: 《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）；1908年伦敦奥运会演讲
modes.key_quote_zh: 奥林匹克比赛中最重要的不是取胜，而是参与；正如生活中最重要的不是征服，而是奋力拼搏。本质不在于凯旋，而在于奋力拼搏。凡参与本奥运会有所获益，其光荣不在于最后获胜，而在于奋力拼搏，不断进取，不在争取胜利，而在努力战斗。
modes.key_quote_en: The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not winning but taking part; the most important thing in life is not triumph but the struggle. The essential thing is not to have conquered but to have fought well. Those who take part in the Olympic Games derive advantage not from having won, but from struggling well.
process_zh: 重新定义成功的标准：从'胜利'转向'参与'
将关注焦点从结果转移至过程
确认参与本身的教育价值和人格塑造意义
以奋斗精神取代胜负二元论的价值判断
process_en: Redefine success: shift from 'victory' to 'participation'
Redirect focus from outcome to process
Affirm the educational value and character-building significance of participation itself
Replace the win-lose binary with a struggle-oriented value judgment
representative_cases_zh: 1908年伦敦奥运会马拉松比赛中，意大利选手多兰多·彼得里（Dorando Pietri）体力透支闯入终点，虽被取消成绩，但其坚持到底的精神赢得了全场起立鼓掌，成为'参与至上'的经典案例
顾拜旦反复强调，奥林匹克运动的价值不在于创造世界纪录，而在于激发每个人的参与热情和努力精神
反例警示：若将'参与至上'理解为降低标准、放弃竞争，就会滑向平庸主义——顾拜旦强调的是在高水平竞争中的参与，而非放弃卓越的努力
representative_cases_en: At the 1908 London Olympics Marathon, Italian runner Dorando Pietri, exhausted, stumbled across the finish line. Though disqualified, his determination earned a standing ovation — a classic case of 'participation supremacy'
Coubertin repeatedly stressed that the value of the Olympic Movement lies not in world records but in inspiring universal participation and effort

Counterexample: interpreting 'participation supremacy' as lowering standards and abandoning competition slides into mediocrity — Coubertin meant participation at the highest competitive level, not the abandonment of excellence

modes.definition_zh: 通过复兴古代奥运会传统来应对现代社会的危机。顾拜旦受到德国考古学家恩斯特·库尔提乌斯对奥林匹亚遗址发掘的启发，认为古代奥运精神可以为现代民族主义和国际冲突提供替代方案。他不是简单复制古代形式，而是创造性地转化古代资源，使其适应现代需求。
modes.definition_en: Reviving the ancient Olympic tradition to address modern social crises. Inspired by German archaeologist Ernst Curtius's excavations at Olympia, Coubertin believed ancient Olympic spirit could offer an alternative to modern nationalism and international conflict. He did not merely copy ancient forms but creatively transformed ancient resources to meet modern needs.
modes.source_chapter: 《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）；《英国教育》（L'Éducation en Angleterre，1888）
modes.key_quote_zh: 复兴古代奥林匹克运动会，不是为了复古，而是为了借助古代的理想来应对现代的挑战。古代奥运会展现了人类追求卓越、追求和平的永恒渴望。
modes.key_quote_en: The revival of the ancient Olympic Games was not an exercise in nostalgia, but a creative transformation of ancient resources to meet modern challenges. The ancient Olympics manifested humanity's eternal quest for excellence and peace.
process_zh: 诊断当代社会面临的核心危机
追溯古代文化资源中的相关智慧
选择性提取可转化的核心元素
创造性重构以适应现代语境
process_en: Diagnose the core crises facing contemporary society
Trace relevant wisdom in ancient cultural resources
Selectively extract transformable core elements
Creatively reconstruct to fit modern context
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦从古希腊奥运会的'神圣休战'传统中提取和平理念，将其转化为现代奥林匹克休战决议，要求各国在奥运期间停止武装冲突
他参考古代奥运的五环标志（代表五大洲），设计了现代奥林匹克五环图案，但赋予其新的象征意义——五大洲的团结与全球运动员的聚会
反例警示：若将古代复兴简单理解为形式上的复制，就会陷入文化保守主义——顾拜旦的创新在于提取古代精神内核，而非照搬古代外在形式
representative_cases_en: Coubertin extracted the peace concept from the ancient Olympic 'Ekecheiria' (sacred truce) tradition and transformed it into the modern Olympic Truce Resolution, calling for cessation of armed conflict during the Games

Drawing on the ancient five rings representing the five continents, he designed the modern Olympic rings symbol but endowed it with new meaning — the unity of the five continents and the gathering of athletes worldwide
Counterexample: treating ancient revival as mere formal copying falls into cultural conservatism — Coubertin's innovation lay in extracting the spiritual core rather than reproducing external forms
modern_applications_zh: 传统资源的创新性使用
文化复兴与现代化平衡

modes.definition_zh: 体育是促进国际理解与和平的有效途径。顾拜旦相信，通过国际体育竞赛，各国青年可以在公平竞争中建立相互尊重和友谊。他称运动员为'和平大使'，主张体育应超越政治分歧，成为连接不同民族和文化的桥梁。
modes.definition_en: Sport is an effective means to promote international understanding and peace. Coubertin believed that through international sporting competitions, young people from different nations could build mutual respect and friendship in fair competition. He called athletes 'ambassadors of peace,' arguing that sport should transcend political divisions and serve as a bridge connecting different peoples and cultures.
modes.source_chapter: 《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）；1894年索邦大学演讲
modes.key_quote_zh: 体育能够把不同国家、不同文化背景的年轻人聚集在一起，在公平的规则下竞争，在尊重的氛围中交流。这就是奥林匹克运动的和平使命。
modes.key_quote_en: Sport can bring together young people from different countries and cultural backgrounds to compete fairly and exchange ideas respectfully. This is the peace mission of the Olympic Movement.
process_zh: 识别国际紧张局势与冲突根源
设计体育交流的跨国机制
创造非政治化的接触空间
培育跨国界的友谊与理解
process_en: Identify international tensions and the roots of conflict
Design cross-border mechanisms for sporting exchange
Create non-political spaces for contact
Foster transnational friendship and understanding
representative_cases_zh: 1936年柏林奥运会，尽管纳粹试图利用奥运会进行种族宣传，但顾拜旦的理想仍在一定程度上实现了不同国家运动员之间的交流
冷战期间，美苏等国的体育交流成为外交破冰的尝试，如1972年'乒乓外交'推动了中美关系缓和
反例警示：若体育被纯粹政治化利用，就会背离奥林匹克和平使命——1972年慕尼黑奥运会恐怖事件、1980年和1984年奥运会的相互抵制都证明了这一点
representative_cases_en: At the 1936 Berlin Olympics, despite Nazi attempts to use the Games for racial propaganda, Coubertin's ideal of cross-border athlete exchange was partially realized
During the Cold War, sporting exchanges between the US and USSR served as diplomatic breakthrough efforts, such as the 1972 'Ping Pong Diplomacy' that eased Sino-US relations

Counterexample: when sport is purely politicized, it背离s the Olympic peace mission — the 1972 Munich Olympics terrorist attack and the mutual boycotts of 1980 and 1984 Games both demonstrate this danger

modes.definition_zh: 坚持业余主义原则，确保体育竞赛的纯洁性和公平性。顾拜旦认为，职业化会腐蚀体育精神，只有业余运动员才能在无经济利益驱动的情况下体现纯粹的竞技道德。这一原则带有精英主义色彩，限制了下层阶级的参与，但维护了体育的精神价值。
modes.definition_en: Maintaining the amateur principle to ensure the purity and fairness of sporting competition. Coubertin believed professionalization would corrupt the spirit of sport; only amateur athletes could demonstrate pure competitive ethics without economic incentives. This principle carried elitist overtones that limited working-class participation, but preserved sport's spiritual values.
modes.key_quote_zh: 业余主义是奥林匹克运动的基石。它确保了竞赛的纯洁性，防止了金钱对体育精神的侵蚀。运动员应为荣誉而战，而非为金钱而赛。
modes.key_quote_en: Amateurism is the cornerstone of the Olympic Movement. It ensures the purity of competition and prevents the corrosion of money on the spirit of sport. Athletes should compete for honor, not for money.
process_zh: 界定业余与职业的明确界限
排除经济利益对竞赛的干扰
确立公平竞争的环境与条件
维护体育的精神价值与道德高度
process_en: Define clear boundaries between amateur and professional
Exclude economic interests from interfering with competition
Establish fair competitive environment and conditions
Preserve sport's spiritual values and moral heights
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦坚决抵制职业运动员参加奥运会，认为他们缺乏真正的体育精神，只是为了金钱而比赛
直到1980年代，国际奥委会才逐步放宽业余主义限制，允许职业运动员参加奥运会，这反映了顾拜旦原则的历史局限性
反例警示：若将业余主义绝对化，就会排除广大劳动者参与奥运的机会——顾拜旦的精英主义倾向与奥林匹克运动的民主化趋势存在内在张力
representative_cases_en: Coubertin firmly opposed professional athletes participating in the Olympics, believing they lacked genuine sporting spirit and competed only for money
It was not until the 1980s that the IOC gradually relaxed amateur restrictions, allowing professional athletes to compete — reflecting the historical limitations of Coubertin's principle
Counterexample: absolute amateurism excludes working-class athletes from Olympic participation — Coubertin's elitism creates inherent tension with the democratizing trend of the Olympic Movement

modes.name_en: Character Forging Method (Moral Education through Sport)
modes.definition_zh: 体育是锻造品格的最佳工具。顾拜旦相信，竞技运动中的挑战、挫折、团队合作和公平竞争能够培养坚韧、勇气、诚实和自律等美德。他将体育视为'道德健身房'，通过身体的锻炼实现精神的上扬，认为竞技中的每一次挑战都是品格成长的机会。
modes.definition_en: Sport is the best tool for forging character. Coubertin believed that the challenges, setbacks, teamwork, and fair play inherent in competitive sports cultivate virtues such as resilience, courage, honesty, and self-discipline. He viewed sport as a 'moral gymnasium,' achieving spiritual elevation through physical training, seeing every challenge in competition as an opportunity for character growth.
modes.source_chapter: 《公共教育笔记》（Notes sur l'éducation publique，1901）
modes.key_quote_zh: 体育能够强有力地锤炼性格，培养所谓的'道德肌肉'。它教会年轻人如何在压力下保持冷静，如何在失败后重新站起，如何尊重对手，如何在胜利时保持谦逊。
modes.key_quote_en: Sport powerfully tempers character, cultivating what may be called 'moral muscles.' It teaches young people how to remain calm under pressure, how to rise after failure, how to respect opponents, and how to stay humble in victory.
process_zh: 选择适合的体育项目和竞赛形式
设置适度的挑战和困难
在实践中体验挫折与成功的双重历练
提炼品格要素并通过反思内化
process_en: Select appropriate sports and competitive formats
Set moderate challenges and difficulties
Experience both setbacks and success through practice
Extract character elements and internalize through reflection
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦认为，体育竞赛中的失败比胜利更具教育价值，因为它教会年轻人如何面对挫折、如何重新开始
他特别强调团队合作运动（如足球、篮球）对培养集体主义精神和社交能力的独特作用
反例警示：若将品格锻造简化为'输不起'的胜负心态，就会培养出脆弱的竞争者——真正的品格锻造需要学会优雅地接受失败
representative_cases_en: Coubertin believed that failure in sport carries greater educational value than victory, as it teaches young people how to face setbacks and start anew
He particularly emphasized team sports (such as football and basketball) for their unique role in cultivating collectivism and social skills
Counterexample: reducing character forging to a 'cannot lose' mentality produces fragile competitors — true character development requires learning to accept defeat gracefully
modern_applications_zh: 逆境训练与心理韧性建设
modern_applications_en: Adversity training and psychological resilience building

modes.definition_zh: 通过仪式和象征物的设计来强化集体认同和精神感召。顾拜旦设计了奥林匹克五环标志（1913年）、奥林匹克旗帜（1914年）、奥运圣火传递（1928年提议）等象征体系，并确立了开幕式、颁奖仪式等程式，使奥林匹克运动具有强烈的宗教般的仪式感，增强了参与者的归属感和使命感。
modes.definition_en: Strengthening collective identity and spiritual inspiration through the design of rituals and symbols. Coubertin designed the Olympic rings logo (1913), the Olympic flag (1914), the Olympic cauldron tradition (proposed 1928), and established ceremonial formats including opening and award ceremonies, giving the Olympic Movement a powerful quasi-religious ritual quality that enhanced participants' sense of belonging and mission.
modes.key_quote_zh: 一个运动如果没有仪式和象征，就缺乏灵魂。五环代表五大洲的团结，圣火象征光明的理想，这些仪式让抽象的理念变得可见、可感、可传承。
modes.key_quote_en: A movement without rituals and symbols lacks soul. The five rings represent the unity of the five continents, the cauldron symbolizes the light of ideals — these rituals make abstract concepts visible, tangible, and transmissible.
process_zh: 提炼核心价值和精神理念
设计具象化的象征符号
建立重复性的仪式程式
强化集体记忆和情感认同
process_en: Extract core values and spiritual concepts
Design concrete symbolic representations
Establish recurring ceremonial formats
Strengthen collective memory and emotional identification
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦设计的五环标志：五个相交的圆环代表五大洲，六种颜色（含白色背景）涵盖所有国旗的颜色，象征全球运动员的团结
他确立了圣火传递仪式，从希腊奥林匹亚采集圣火，通过火炬接力传递到主办城市，强化了古代与现代的连接感
反例警示：若仪式流于形式主义，就会沦为空洞的表演——顾拜旦强调仪式必须承载真实的精神内涵，否则只会产生虚假的认同
representative_cases_en: Coubertin's five-ring design: five interlocking rings represent the five continents, and six colors (including white background) encompass all national flag colors, symbolizing global athletic unity
He established the cauldron relay tradition, collecting flame from Olympia in Greece and passing it via torch relay to the host city, strengthening the connection between ancient and modern

Counterexample: when rituals degenerate into empty formalism, they become hollow performances — Coubertin insisted that rituals must carry genuine spiritual content, otherwise they produce false identification

modes.definition_zh: 通过建立持久性的国际组织来保障理想的实现。顾拜旦不仅提出理念，更创建了国际奥委会（IOC）这一常设机构，设计了其治理结构、决策程序和发展战略。他认识到，没有制度保障的理想只能是空想，因此他强调机构建设和治理架构的重要性。
modes.definition_en: Ensuring the realization of ideals through establishing durable international institutions. Coubertin not only proposed ideas but also created the International Olympic Committee (IOC) as a standing institution, designing its governance structure, decision-making procedures, and development strategy. He recognized that ideals without institutional support are mere dreams, hence his emphasis on organizational construction and governance architecture.
modes.source_chapter: 《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）；1894年索邦大学演讲
modes.key_quote_zh: 理念需要载体，理想需要机构。国际奥委会不仅是一个管理机构，更是奥林匹克精神的守护者、传播者和创新者。
modes.key_quote_en: Ideas need vessels; ideals need institutions. The IOC is not merely an administrative body but the guardian, disseminator, and innovator of the Olympic spirit.
process_zh: 明确组织的使命和价值观
设计合理的治理结构和权力分配
建立透明的决策机制和监督程序
确保组织的持续运作和适应性变革
process_en: Clarify the organization's mission and values
Design reasonable governance structure and power distribution
Establish transparent decision-making mechanisms and oversight procedures
Ensure continuous operation and adaptive transformation
representative_cases_zh: 1894年索邦大学国际会议上，顾拜旦推动成立了国际奥林匹克委员会，设计了其成员遴选机制、决策程序和资金保障
他确立了国际奥委会作为'非政府、非营利、永久性'国际组织的定位，确保其独立于各国政府之外
反例警示：若机构设置过于集权，就会丧失民主性和适应性——顾拜旦晚年逐渐集中的权力模式引发争议，表明机构设计需要在效率与制衡之间保持张力
representative_cases_en: At the 1894 Sorbonne International Congress, Coubertin pushed for the establishment of the International Olympic Committee, designing its member selection mechanism, decision-making procedures, and funding guarantees
He positioned the IOC as a 'non-governmental, non-profit, permanent' international organization, ensuring its independence from national governments

Counterexample: overly centralized institutional design loses democracy and adaptability — Coubertin's late-life increasingly concentrated power model sparked controversy, showing the need for tension between efficiency and checks in institutional design

modes.definition_zh: 体育与艺术应当融合，共同服务于人的全面发展。顾拜旦认为古希腊的奥运会本身就包含艺术竞赛，现代奥运会也应恢复这一传统。他主张建筑、雕塑、绘画、文学、音乐等艺术形式应与体育竞技并列，共同体现人类的创造力，实现完整的人格教育。
modes.definition_en: Sport and art should integrate, serving together the comprehensive development of human beings. Coubertin believed the ancient Olympics already included art competitions, and the modern Games should restore this tradition. He advocated that architecture, sculpture, painting, literature, music and other art forms should stand alongside athletic competitions, collectively manifesting human creativity and achieving complete personality education.
modes.key_quote_zh: 没有艺术的体育是盲目的，没有体育的艺术是空洞的。奥林匹亚的理想从来都是身心俱美。
modes.key_quote_en: Sport without art is blind; art without sport is empty. The Olympic ideal has always been beauty of both body and mind.
process_zh: 追溯古代体育与艺术融合的传统
设计艺术竞赛的机制和类别
建立体育与艺术的对话空间
实现完整的人格教育和创造力培养
process_en: Trace the ancient tradition of sport-art integration
Design mechanisms and categories for art competitions
Create dialogic spaces between sport and art
Achieve complete personality education and creativity cultivation
representative_cases_zh: 1912年斯德哥尔摩奥运会首次正式设立艺术竞赛，包括文学、音乐、绘画、雕塑和建筑五个类别，顾拜旦本人获得文学类金奖（以笔名'乔治·霍尔'发表的《体育颂》）
他主张现代奥运村应兼具体育功能与美学价值，将建筑艺术纳入奥运设施设计标准
反例警示：若艺术竞赛沦为体育的附庸或装饰，就会失去其独立价值——顾拜旦强调艺术应作为与体育平等的教育形式，而非仅仅装饰性元素
representative_cases_en: At the 1912 Stockholm Olympics, art competitions were formally established for the first time, including literature, music, painting, sculpture, and architecture — Coubertin himself won the literature gold medal under the pen name 'George Hohrod' for his 'Ode to Sport'
He argued that modern Olympic villages should combine sporting functionality with aesthetic value, incorporating architectural art into Olympic facility design standards

Counterexample: when art competitions become mere appendages or decorations to sport, they lose their independent value — Coubertin insisted art should serve as an educational form equal to sport, not merely a decorative element

modes.definition_zh: 通过规则和仪式将暴力冲突转化为和平竞争。顾拜旦继承了古代奥运会的'神圣休战'（Ekecheiria）传统，主张在国际冲突频发的时代，体育竞赛可以成为替代战争的'文明战场'。他将竞技规则视为文明秩序的缩影，强调公平竞争优于不择手段的胜利。
modes.definition_en: Transforming violent conflict into peaceful competition through rules and rituals. Coubertin inherited the ancient Olympic 'Ekecheiria' (sacred truce) tradition, arguing that in an era of frequent international conflict, sporting competition could serve as a 'civilized battlefield' alternative to war. He viewed competitive rules as a microcosm of civilized order, emphasizing fair play over victory at any cost.
modes.key_quote_zh: 战争是人类最古老的竞争形式，但它带来了毁灭而非进步。奥林匹克运动会提供了一种更高级的竞争方式——在规则之下、在尊重之中、在友谊之内追求卓越。
modes.key_quote_en: War is humanity's most ancient form of competition, but it brings destruction rather than progress. The Olympic Games offer a higher form of competition — pursuing excellence within rules, within respect, within friendship.
process_zh: 承认竞争是人类社会的必然现象
设计公平规则的竞技框架
将对抗纳入仪式化的和平轨道
以和平方式实现卓越追求
process_en: Acknowledge competition as an inevitable feature of human society
Design fair-ruled competitive frameworks
Channel confrontation into ritualized peaceful tracks
Pursue excellence through peaceful means
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦复兴古代奥运会的'神圣休战'传统，呼吁各国在奥运期间停止军事冲突，让运动员安全通行
他设计了严格的竞赛规则和裁判制度，确保所有参与者在同一规则下公平竞争，这被视为文明秩序的微观模型
反例警示：若竞争规则被强者任意修改，就会沦为弱肉强食的合法化伪装——顾拜旦强调规则的普遍性和不可侵犯性，这是和平竞争的前提
representative_cases_en: Coubertin revived the ancient Olympic 'Ekecheiria' tradition, calling on nations to cease military conflict during the Games and allow safe passage for athletes
He designed strict competition rules and referee systems, ensuring all participants compete fairly under the same rules — viewed as a microcosm of civilized order

Counterexample: when competitive rules are arbitrarily modified by the strong, they become a legitimizing disguise for might-makes-right — Coubertin emphasized the universality and inviolability of rules, the prerequisite for peaceful competition
